claim_boundaries: This is a two-case holdout pilot selected and frozen at detector commit d9754d0 before evaluation. It is a workflow proof, not a stable estimate of real-world performance.
The holdout cases are audited for case ID, advisory, source-pair, diff URL, and upstream-commit overlap against the measured OSS seed and promoted CVE manifests.
Detector misses are retained as measured failures. Any post-hoc detector improvement must be evaluated on a new untouched partition.

systems.label: VeriSec Agent holdout pilot
systems.notes: Blind evaluation of two previously unpromoted real OSS security patches at detector freeze commit d9754d0.
